s: Din beraka rishona beyotzer ubo v' seipim: sheba berakot tiqqenu chakamim liqriat shema: bashshachar — shettayim lepaneha veachat leachareha, ubaereb — shettayim lepaneha ushettayim leachareha, vesameku otan al pasuq "sheba bayyom hillaltika vego'". Beraka rishona potachat be"baruk": "baruk atta Hashem elohenu melek haolam yotzer or ubore choshek". Vetiqqenu lehazkir middat layla bayyom, lehotzi milleb hamminim sheomerim shemmi shebbara or lo bara choshek. Vechotemet be"baruk": "baruk atta Hashem yotzer hammeorot". Veim taa veamar "baruk atta Hashem elohenu melek haolam asher bidbaro maarib arabim" venizkar miyyad veamar "yotzer or" ad siyyum habberaka vechatam be"yotzer hammeorot" — yatza. Abal im amar "asher bidbaro maarib arabim" velo amar (miyyad) "yotzer or" ap al pi shechatam be"yotzer hammeorot" — lo yatza, shehare kol petichat habberaka lo hayeta ketiqqunah (shello berek kelal al yetzirat haor, mah sheen ken keshennizkar miyyad veamar "yotzer or" — tiqqen tauto uberak al yetzirat haor). Veim amar "baruk atta Hashem elohenu melek haolam yotzer or ubore choshek asher bidbaro maarib arabim bechokma poteach" ku' apillu ad siyyum habberaka vechatam be"yotzer hammeorot" — yatza, shekkevan sheppetichat habberaka vachatimatah ketiqqunah ap al pi shebbaemtza shinna mimmatbea shettabeu chakamim — yatza bediabad. Abal im chatam "hammaarib arabim" ap al pi sheppatach be"yotzer or" bilbad veamar kol habberaka ketiqqunah ad hachatima — lo yatza, shekkol habberaka tzerika lihyot petichatah vachatimatah ketiqqunah apillu bediabad. Vekol maqom shello yatza im lo nizkar shettaa ad sheggamar "ahaba rabba" o "ahabat olam" — lo yapsiq lachazor le"yotzer or" benah liqriat shema, ella yomar "yotzer or" achar tepillat y"ch. Veap al pi shemmaqdim qeriat shema lebirkat "yotzer" shetiqqenu lepaneha — en zeh meakkeb bediabad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s':

Yesh omerim shehaqqedushsha shebb"yotzer" yakol hayyachid leomrah, sheenah doma laqqedushsha shebbattepilla sheomerim "naqdishak" o "neqaddesh" sheanachnu maqdishim oto veen rashshay lehaqdish bepachot measara, abal qedushsha shel "yotzer" sheen anu maqdishin oto ella mazkirin haqqedushsha sheomerim lo meshortayv — muttar beyachid, sheenah ella kemo sippur debarim. Veken qedushshat "uba letziyyon" kevan sheenah ella qeriat pesuqim bealma — en bekak kelum. Veyesh omerim sheen hayyachid omer lo qedushshat "yotzer" velo qedushshat "uba letziyyon", ella keshemmaggia laqqedushsha shebb"yotzer" — yomar "veomerim beyira qadosh vehaopannim ku' veomerim baruk". Vetob lachush ledibrehem velizzaher sheyyachid yomrena beniggun uteamim keqore battora. Abal hamminhag kassebara harishona. Ukesheonin qedushsha zo betzibbur — yesh laanot beqol ram, veyesh lomar otah meyushshab. Velo sheyyesheb im haya omed, ella sheim haya yosheb — en lo laamod liqdushsha zo kemo liqdushsha shebbattepilla:

Yesh lomar "maaritzim umaqdishim umamlikim"— hakkol bem"m velo benav"n, ki kol nussach habberaka hu leshon miqra uleshon miqra hu bem"m velo benav"n (veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lomar benav"n):

Berakot ellu shel qeriat shema — hashsheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chobatan apillu mi shehu baqi. Veenan domot litpilla sheen hashsheliach tzibbur motzi ella mi sheeno baqi, lepi shehattepilla baqqashat rachamim hi vetzarik kol echad lebaqqesh rachamim al atzmo im yodea, mah sheen ken bibrakot ellu vekayyotze bahen. Umikkol maqom, eno motzi ella sheliach tzibbur et hatztzibbur, dehaynu kesheyyesh sham t' hashshomeim veonin amen. Abal kesheen t' shomein — yachid hu, veen yachid motzi et hayyachid apillu mi sheeno baqi ella bebirkat hannehenin ubirkat hammitzvot vekayyotze bahen mishshear kol habberakot. Chutz mibbirkat qeriat shema vekol birkot hashshachar shehen birkot shebach vehodaa, venittaqnu leomram bepiv, o sheyyishma otan berab am shehi hadrat melek keshet' shomein meechad veonin acharayv amen. Ubirkat hammazon ap al pi shehu gam ken birkat hodaa al heabar, mikkol maqom kevan shehu birkat hannehenin — heqellu bahen. Umikkol maqom hoil ubirkot qeriat shema hen arukkot — en lismok al shemiatan mehashsheliach tzibbur apillu betzibbur, ki shemma yipneh lebabo beemtza habberaka lidbarim acherim velo yishma mehashsheliach tzibbur. Laken yesh lomar kol habberaka benachat im hashsheliach tzibbur, veaz ap al pi sheyipneh lebabo (veyiqra miqtzatah belo kavvana) — yatza (shehakkavvana enah meakkebet bediabad ella bepasuq rishon shel qeriat shema ubibraka rishona shel tepillat y"ch). Veyizzaher lemaher lesayyem habberaka qodem sheyyesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur kede sheyyaaneh amen acharayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a. Veyesh omerim sheachar siyyum birkat "habbocher beammo yisrael beahaba" — lo yaaneh amen, shello lehapsiq ben qeriat shema labberaka shellepaneha, kemo sheasur lehapsiq ben kol debar mitzva o debar hanaa shemmebarekin alayv lehabberaka shellepanayv. Veyesh omerim sheonin amen gam achar beraka zo. Veen chashash bemah shemmapsiq benah liqriat shema, lepi shebbirkot qeriat shema enan domot lishar birkot hamitzvot, shehare en mebarekin "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu liqrot qeriat shema", ella berakot bipne atzman hen, vetiqqenu lebarek otan qodem qeriat shema. Veken hamminhag pashut bimdinot ellu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"a:

Im taa hashsheliach tzibbur bebirkat "yotzer" beinyan shetztzarik laamod acher tachtayv, im taa qodem qedushsha — hare zeh haomed tachtayv tzarik lachazor lerosh habberaka, kemo betoeh bebirkat hattepilla ukemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"v. Veim taa leachar sheanu hatztzibbur "qadosh ku'" — lo yatchil merosh habberaka, mippene sheaniyyat qadosh chashuba kesiyyum beraka leinyan zeh, umi"vehaopannim" hu kemo rosh beraka acheret, veken aniyyat "baruk kebod ku'" hu kemo siyyum beraka leinyan zeh, ve"lael baruk" hu kemo rosh beraka acheret. Lepikak, im taa be"opannim" — yachazor veyatchil zeh shettachtayv mi"vehaopannim". Veim taa mi"lael baruk neimot" veelaka — yachazor veyatchil "lael baruk ku'":

Yesh omerim sheen lomar "or chadash ku'", lepi shetztzarik lomar meen peticha vachatima samuk lachatima, vezeh eno meen peticha vachatima, lepi shechakamim sidderu habberaka al or hammitchaddesh bekol yom velo al or heatid lehitchaddesh. Veyesh meyashshebim hamminhag lomar shehi meen peticha vachatima, lepi she"yotzer or" zehu haor shebbara haqqadosh baruk hu bev' yeme bereshit ugenazo latztzaddiqim leatid labo, veal or zeh neemar: "vehaleku goyim leorek", vezehu sheomer "or chadash" shechiddesh bev' yeme bereshit — atid haqqadosh baruk hu lechaddesh lanu:
